result.summary: The page is largely clean; most clipped items are intentional carousel/viewport behavior and were excluded. One minor visibility concern stands out with the top-right circular action button.

issues.description: The circular button in the top-right corner (near the status bar) is extremely faint/low-contrast against the white header background, making its boundary and purpose hard to perceive; only the small red badge dot is clearly visible.
issues.suggestion: Increase the button's contrast by darkening its border/background or using a clearer filled icon style so it remains discernible in light mode while preserving the notification badge.
